search.snippet: An Adamant helm (h1) is a helmet that can be obtained by completing medium Treasure Trails. It requires 30 Defence to equip and has the same defence bonuses as an adamant full helm.

search.snippet: The adamant med helm is a medium helmet made of adamantite. This helm requires 30 Defence to wear. It provides more protection than its mithril counterpart. It can be made at level 73 Smithing using an adamantite bar, granting 62.5 experience.
search.title: Adamant med helm - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: An Adamant helm (h1) is a helmet obtained from the level 2 Treasure trails or bought from other players. It cannot be made using the Smithing skill. Players wear it for its unique design.
